title: VIC, NSW & QLD - Maintain the Network
current_summary: Planned maintenance affecting the access network in parts of VIC, NSW and QLD has been completed. Work ran from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on 31 July 2026, with a brief interruption of up to 15 minutes for some services. Services are restored and stable. No further impact is expected.

updates.content: Planned maintenance on the access network in VIC, NSW and QLD has been completed. The work took place overnight from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on 31 July 2026. Some services may have experienced a brief interruption of up to 15 minutes during the window. Services are back online and performing as expected. We will continue to monitor. Thank you for your patience.
